$comment: UI lane, phase 4: the new-world menu (your own system), mods, saves, the controls card, and the camera modes (cinematic, walk, follow, photo). Run: node _harness/shots.mjs _harness/specs/ui-worlds.json --port=5193 --quality=low. Each shot opens its own world (?intro=0 by the harness).

shots.name: ui4-newworld-custom
shots.script: await G.ui_.open('newworld', 'custom'); G.worlds_.newWorld.spec({ star: 'K', worlds: [{ kind: 'terran', species: 'plains-folk', era: 'stone' }, { kind: 'desert', species: 'hive', era: 'bronze' }, { kind: 'ice', species: 'cold-folk', era: 'stone' }] }); return G.worlds_.newWorld.url();

shots.name: ui4-mods
shots.script: const t = await (await fetch('/mods/species-stone-singers.json')).text(); await G.ui_.open('mods'); await G.worlds_.mods.take(t, 'stone-singers.json'); return G.worlds_.mods.last();

shots.name: ui4-saves
shots.script: await G.worlds_.saves.save('Two worlds, day one'); await G.ui_.open('saves'); return (await G.worlds_.saves.list()).length;

shots.name: ui4-cinematic
shots.script: const s = (await G.query('settlements', { planet: 0 })).sort((a, b) => b.population - a.population)[0]; G.cam_.dolly({ kind: 'settlement', id: s.id, planet: 0 }); return G.cam_.mode();

shots.name: ui4-walk
shots.script: const s = (await G.query('settlements', { planet: 0 })).sort((a, b) => b.population - a.population)[0]; G.cam_.walk({ kind: 'settlement', id: s.id, planet: 0 }); return G.cam_.mode();

shots.name: ui4-photo
shots.script: G.cam_.photo(true); G.cam_.setLens({ frame: '2.39:1', filter: 'warm', blur: 0.6 }); G.cam_.focusAt(innerWidth * 0.45, innerHeight * 0.6); return G.cam_.lens();
